die: layer and head (identical ports; only ck / rst sit at another x on the head die's S face: ck 2335.8 vs 2316.4, rst 2448.1 vs 2446.9 um)
domain: stream 1.2 GHz (ck), rst active low (die reset net, as every r8/r9 glue block)

decision.choice: attention stays UNSPLIT in arithmetic; the collector is a frame-atomic row gather (FIFOs + register stages, no arithmetic)
why: the core's attention engine ot_hdc_v41x_attn (via ot_hdc_v41x_att_adapt in ot_hdc_core_v41x, X_ATT) computes s = q.k as a csum over the D dims and pv = p.v as a csum over the T rows in golden row order (padded pairwise tree over ceil(T/8) chunk sums, merged by ot_hdc_v41x_attn_merge); the softmax (max, exp, sum, sink, divide) is on the stream unit, not in the engine

selected compressed rows live on their owner stack (ot_chip_v41x_ckv_die_service_cr: home stack id[7:6]), so a per-stack p.v over the stack's own rows, or a flash-style max/LSE rescale merge, changes the FP32 summation order: NOT bit-exact with the golden. No such merge RTL exists and none is built

exact splits need no cross-stack arithmetic: a stack may own complete outputs (q.k score rows of the rows it holds: each score is a csum over that row's dims only; p.v dims whose every row it holds; or forwarded rows). The collector only moves those finished words
the existing exact precedent is the same shape: ot_chip_v41x_ckv_die_service_cr gathers rows from four sources into a rank-addressed buffer so the engine sees golden row order
decision.constraint_on_svc: the scan service (svc kind) must send only finished, exact result frames on od (no partial sums across rows); if a split needs a cross-stack sum it must be re-derived as a golden-order pairwise tree first (not planned). Recorded for the svc owner

rtl.macros: 8 x ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2 (2 per stack: 256 words x 512 b frame buffer)
rtl.params: STG 7 (pin register + 7 transport stages from the W / E faces to the centre, <= ~380 um a stage), OSTG 1, DEPTH 256, PACE 2

inputs.ports: cSW, cSE, cNW, cNE (515 b): one per scan service (HBM stack), delivered by the hub end block dsfd_m2l_vr_512x1__hco_<st> (ot_meso_fifo) in ck: [0] valid, [512:1] data, [513] live, [514] fault
inputs.framing: hub common framing (contracts_hub.json common_rules.framing): header word then len raw data words
inputs.header: data[511:508] type, [507:500] tag, [499:492] op, [491:480] len, [479:0] payload carried unchanged (the VM destination: the producer's address fields)

types.5 fault: forwarded whole and raises fault bit 15
types.4 done/status: len 0; one per stack per job, NOT forwarded; the four are merged into one DONE

inputs.rate: one word a cycle per stack, valid-only, never throttled
inputs.capacity: per job each stack sends <= DEPTH = 256 words (headers included); the VM issues the next job's work to the stacks only after this job's DONE. Above that: fail closed (bit 11). A frame longer than 255 data words is a format fault

output.ports: vd (514 b, vr format: [0] rst_n, [1] valid, [513:2] data) + vf (forwarded clock = ck through a kept ot_fwd_clk_inv) -> station chain -> VM ratio CDC dsfd_r2l_vr_512x1__hcol
output.pacing: the VM end is ot_ratio_cdc_fifo with no w_rdy back: at most ONE word every PACE = 2 cycles (0.6 G words/s into the 0.9 GHz reader), as the selector
output.order: frames atomic (no word of another frame inside a frame); each stack's frames in its own order; a frame starts only when all its words are buffered; stacks granted round robin at frame boundaries

collector_words.4 DONE: [507:500] tag, [15:11] 0, [10:0] OR of the four stacks' DONE [10:0]; leaves after every frame the four stacks sent before their DONE
collector_words.5 FAULT: [507:500] tag of the last DONE, [45:30] 0, [15:11] sticky fault bits; at a frame boundary (a frame in flight is completed first, zero words if its data is gone); after it no data and no DONE until reset

fault_bits.12: format (unknown type, DONE len != 0, frame longer than 255 data words)
fault_bits.14: input lane fault bit, or a valid word while the lane is not live
fault_bits.15: a stack sent a fault frame

vm_sequencer_rules: write every data word of a frame at the address its header names (the image is then independent of the merge order)
issue the next job's work to the four stacks only after this job's DONE
a FAULT word aborts the job: reset the collector and re-run

cycle_cost.latency: pin + 7 stages + parser + FIFO (bypass) + count + decision (registered, 1 pre cycle) + slot + OSTG 1 + pin: ~13-14 ck cycles from the first word at the pin to vd when the lane is idle
cycle_cost.throughput: 0.5 word / ck cycle out (PACE 2) against up to 4 words / cycle in: a job's attention results leave in 2 x (sum of the four stacks' words) ck cycles. COMPOSE owns the model term: e.g. 640 score rows + 4 x ~10 headers = ~680 words -> ~1,360 ck cycles (1.13 us) per q.k job on this path. A wider col_vm lane (generator change, or a w_rdy back from the CDC for PACE 4/3) is the lever if this path is on the critical path; the svc -> VM direct lane (a<st>, 1,024 b) is the alternative carrier

generator_notes: r9 collector input hco end blocks drop the meso FIFO w_rdy (valid-only lane): consistent with this contract
head die master differs only in ck / rst x; one RTL, the head view needs its own route (same RTL) or the generator aligns ck/rst x across dies
